363.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Rude Awakening
english.objective: Speak with Shadow Priest Sarvis.
english.detail:
About time you woke up. We were ready to toss you into the fire with the others, but it looks like you made it.

I am Mordo, the caretaker of the crypt of Deathknell. And you are the Lich King's slave no more.

Speak with Shadow Priest Sarvis in the chapel at the base of the hill, he will tell you more of what you must know.
english.complete:
Another of the walking dead, hm? Must have been quite a shock, waking up in the crypt with only the cold and Mordo to greet you...

I see the confusion on your face. Let me try to explain our... situation... to you.

We have been freed from the control of the Lich King by our new leader, Lady Sylvanas. The Dark Lady guides us in our war against the hated Scourge and the holdouts of humanity who dog our every step.

364.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: The Mindless Ones
english.objective: Shadow Priest Sarvis wants you to kill 8 Mindless Zombies and 8 Wretched Zombies.
english.detail:
We Forsaken are at war with the Lich King's army of the Scourge: necromantically raised armies of the undead, foul beasts of the north, and tormented spectres.

The northern part of the village has become overrun with the Mindless Ones, and they must be destroyed. Destroy them, show them no mercy, our former brothers and sisters as they might be. The Fallen are nothing but The Lich King's slaves.
english.progress: You will not go far in this new life if you are unable to kill even the weakest of zombies, <name>. Do not return until you have success to report.
english.complete:
It is unfortunate that the Scourge cannot be brought into the fold, their large numbers would be useful in the battles ahead.

But they will not join us, so we have no choice but to destroy them.

376.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: The Damned
english.objective: Novice Elreth requires 6 Scavenger Paws and 6 Duskbat Wings.
english.detail:
My duties include tending to our wounded warriors, tailoring armor and clothes, and assisting Shadow Priest Sarvis with whatever else he might need.

From the look of it, you'll be enlisted in his service also... hunting the Mindless Ones, if I know his mind. Well, if you'd like to stay in one piece--and I've no doubt you do--perhaps I can help. I'm running out of paws and wings, and if you bring me some, I'll find some armor for you. You'll find a good number of wolves and bats to the south.
english.progress: Do try your best to keep yourself unharmed until I get you some armor.
english.complete:
Thank you, <name>. This armor should help you out.

Hopefully, it should do you more good than the last one to wear it...

3901.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Rattling the Rattlecages
english.objective: Kill 12 Rattlecage Skeletons, and then return to Shadow Priest Sarvis in Deathknell when you are done.
english.detail:
You've shown your potential to the Forsaken under normal circumstances <Name> - now let's see you under pressure.

The Rattlecage skeletons, more mindless minions of the Lich King, are a tougher foe than the zombies you have faced thus far.  Again, thin their numbers and prove yourself to the Forsaken.  Do not tarry - when you are done, speak to me again.
english.progress: Those who dally in this task might as well end up wandering about aimlessly like our fallen brothers and sisters in the village. Let's hope you will fare better than them, yes?
english.complete:
I am finished with you, <name> - you have shown yourself to be worthy of the freedom that you have been given. Many will stand against you for what you have become, but know that no matter what they may try to do against us, we are free and will not be shackled again.

Take these and be on your way. You have much to accomplish, <class>.

3902.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Scavenging Deathknell
english.objective: Search Deathknell and the vicinity for 6 pieces of Scavenged Goods, and return them to Deathguard Saltain.
english.detail:
You there!  If you're looking for something to make yourself useful, then listen up!

We need fresh out-of-the-ground recruits to head into Deathknell and search for any sort of useful equipment.  Most likely, they'll be in stacks of boxes.  We expect more recruits to be rising soon, and unless we want them to stumble about naked we had better get to scavenging!

Well get to work, you miserable bag of bones!  I'm not going to reward those without some hustle.
english.progress: Have you managed to scavenge up some useful items for us? There is no shame in reusing that which has been tossed aside. No one is going to give us any handouts - we Forsaken will fend for ourselves!
english.complete: Great work <name>, I knew you weren't useless. Here - have one of the better items I've found out of the lots that have been collected so far.

6395.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Marla's Last Wish
english.objective: Bring Samuel Fipps' Remains to Marla's Grave, then return to Novice Elreth.
english.detail:
My friend Marla Fipps lived with her husband Samuel before the plague, but when the plague came Samuel succumbed and joined the Scourge's ranks.

Marla was spared an undeath only to die at the hands of her now mindless husband.  So strong was her love, however, that her last dying wish was to be buried with her beloved Samuel.

Samuel Fipps roams at a ruined camp along the road northeast of Deathknell.  Defeat him and grant Marla's wish: bury him at her grave, in the first row of our graveyard.
english.progress: We must respect our dead, <name>. It is one of the ways in which we differ from the Scourge...
english.complete: You have done a good deed today, <name>. Although our struggle against the Scourge continues, let us hope that Marla and Samuel will find peace together in their final resting place.

380.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Night Web's Hollow
english.objective: Executor Arren wants you to kill 10 Young Night Web Spiders and 8 Night Web Spiders.
english.detail:
One of our greatest struggles is obtaining the natural resources we need to survive. Gold was scarce even in the height of the Alliance's power.

There is a gold mine to the northwest that has been overrun with spiders. We need gold from the mine, but we can't very well get it while the spiders are crawling around in there. I've not much manpower to commit to the task, so we'll just have to do it little by little.

Get up there and see what you can do for us, <Name>.
english.progress: Be wary of the spiders' venom, <name>. If you feel a sharp burning, you may want to have it looked at.
english.complete:
Hmm, well, it's a start. It'll take a few weeks or months to fully clean out the infestation. After that, we'll have to get down there with some torches to burn away the webbing.

You've done your duty well, <name>, I'm sure I can find something else for you to do.

381.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: The Scarlet Crusade
english.objective: Bring Executor Arren 12 Scarlet Armbands from Scarlet Converts and Scarlet Initiates.
english.detail:
You'll be happy to know we appear to be making progress in the mine, thanks in no small part to your efforts.  We can now turn our eyes to other concerns.

My scouts have reported that a detachment of the Scarlet Crusade is setting up a camp southeast of here. The Scarlet Crusade is a despicable organization that hunts us, and they will not rest until every undead--Lich King's Scourge or no--is destroyed. We must strike first!

Be careful, their unholy zeal makes them dangerous adversaries.
english.progress: Those fools... They happily send themselves to their own graves.
english.complete:
If only they listened to reason, eh, <name>? Perhaps we could sit them down for reasonable discourse... ha!

Light-blinded fools.

382.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: The Red Messenger
english.objective: Kill Meven Korgal, the messenger, at the Crusader camp, then return any information you find to Executor Arren.
english.detail:
Reports from my superiors in Brill indicate that an agent of the Scarlet Crusade was dispatched from the Scarlet Monastery and sent here to Deathknell. According to the reports, the messenger possesses important information on his person. I do not have further details, but whatever it is, we must have it!

You're the most qualified person I have to send, <Name>. Find that messenger and bring me whatever information you can find.
english.complete:
Hmm... Let's see what you've got...

<He begins to rifle through the documents you recovered.>

Some news of their exploits against us... Worthless. Scouting reports... New orders, "Continue to build up a camp near the ruined city..." Nothing we didn't know already... Ah, what's this? A map of the dispositions of some of their field commanders and agents! We can use this.

383.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Vital Intelligence
english.objective: Deliver the Scarlet Crusade Documents to Executor Zygand in Brill.
english.detail:
These will need to be taken to my superior, Executor Zygand, in Brill. With this information, we'll be able to deal a decisive blow to the Scarlet Crusade. Your services have been useful here in Deathknell, but I need someone to deliver this to Zygand, and I believe he'll be able to find you more appropriate work.

Take the road north out of Deathknell. Soon after entering Tirisfal proper, you'll hit a crossroads. Take the eastern fork, and keep going east. You'll pass Cold Hearth Manor along the way.
english.complete:
Yes, this is very good. You've done well in obtaining this information, <name>. Hmm... names of the officers in the Tirisfal Glades...

Imagine the blow we could deal to the morale of those bloody zealots if we were to kill their leaders in one swift strike.

8.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: A Rogue's Deal
english.objective: Deliver the Nondescript Letter to Innkeeper Renee in Tirisfal Glades.
english.detail:
Hey, mate! Do a favor for a young man who's been fighting more than his fair share of mindless zombies and spiders?

I got this here letter that needs to go to Brill... to an innkeeper named Renee something-or-other. Don't really matter none what her last name is.

Anyway, it's a nice cozy little place full of victims of the plague trying to make their way in the world. And it be a great spot for you to rest too if the need arises. You should check it out... you do and I'll pay you well.
english.progress:
Yes? Yes? What is it?

The forsaken; they certainly do have huge appetites. Make yourself at home... yes, rest those weary bones. My name's Renee if you need anything at all.
english.complete:
Oh? A letter? Wonderful news! I've been waiting on word from my dear old mother in Deathknell. Such a saint, she is. I wonder how she's holding up.

What? Too cheery? Not buying it, are you?

Well, get lost then... it's really no business who the letter's from anyway. Go on! Get lost!

Come back when you've got some coin to spend... loafer.

Next thing you know, you'll be coming back to rest after a long days adventure or some stupid thing like that.

590.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: A Rogue's Deal
english.objective: Defeat Calvin Montague in Deathknell.
english.detail:
What?

What?!

You want money? I don't owe you any money.

Letter? What letter? Oh, you wanna fight then? All right, mate... let's do this! Owe you any money...
english.complete:
Incredible! What skill!

Thought you'd be easy prey, <name>. Got me good, you did.

Here's the coin I promised... not as much as I said it'd be, but that's on a count o' me lying to ya in the first place.

3095.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Simple Scroll
english.objective: Read the Simple Scroll and speak to Dannal Stern in Deathknell.
english.detail: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the warrior trainer Dannal. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
english.progress:
Ah, so you've arrived. Good. I overheard that a few others were able to escape "death" and were heading into town. Perhaps that resilence will pay off in the future also.

You may thank Sylvanas for your freedom... freedom of mind and body. Though you still remain tortured by the plague and its effects, you are now free to come and go as you see fit.
english.complete:
I will be here to train you as you grow in experience... find me as often as you like. I charge a minimal fee, but you'll find everything I can teach you to be worthwhile.

Go now and test your skill. Many more things will become known to you as you gain experience, some of which I am unable to discuss with you here. Just know that Sylvanas will need warriors with your type of strength in the future. You will be the backbone of our salvation. Do not forget it.

3096.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Encrypted Scroll
english.objective: Read the Encrypted Scroll and speak to David Trias in Deathknell.
english.detail: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the rogue trainer David Trias. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
english.progress: So you've made it? Good, we'll have need of more rogues as time goes on. The Shadowstalkers will probably wind up finding you when they think the time's right, so don't go and slip up or do anything you might regret. They need talented agents... not pickpockets and fools.
english.complete: I spend most of my time here in the inn keeping an eye out for new faces and just keeping tabs on up-and-coming prospects. Keep your nose clean and I'll do what I can to teach you a few things. Just come back to me whenever you want, and we'll see if you're ready for a new skill or two.

3097.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Hallowed Scroll
english.objective: Read the Hallowed Scroll and speak to Dark Cleric Duesten in the church in Deathknell.
english.detail: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the priest trainer Duesten. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
english.progress:
Ah, so between fire, plague, rioting, and much worse, one more of the "faithful" comes to my door. Well, let me bid you welcome, <class>. And allow me a moment to explain a thing or two before you decide it's time for you to seek whatever drives you forward: the Holy Light no longer concerns you, the spirits of your forefathers are fairy tales, and creatures from the Nether don't want you.

Do you understand me so far?
english.complete: There is only one thing you must know: we have survived through will alone. It is faith in ourselves that separates us from others, and with our powers, we will cause great change in all of Azeroth. The weak will come to lean on you. The lepers will call you Lord. And the ignorant will look to you for guidance. It is my duty to make sure you have the necessary tools so when the time comes, you are prepared. As you grow in experience, seek me out. I will teach you greater powers if you are ready.

3098.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Glyphic Scroll
english.objective: Read the Glyphic Scroll and speak to Isabella in the church in Deathknell.
english.detail: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the mage trainer Isabella. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
english.progress: I knew you would come to me, <name>. Not because you do not have the will to follow your own path, but because we are kindred spirits. We both have felt pain. We have both suffered. And now we want the power to take back what we know is ours: this land, our lives, our destinies. But there is much for you to learn still.
english.complete:
You must return to me often if you are to become powerful enough to destroy those who would oppose us. The rules of magic still apply to you, <name>. You will still find corruption follows you like hungry wolves in the night. You will find its caress is not unlike an addiction, an old lover still wanting to be by your side. But these things can be staved off. These things will only control you if you allow them to.

Go now, return to me when you've grown more powerful.

3099.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Tainted Scroll
english.objective: Read the Tainted Scroll and speak to Maximillion in Deathknell.
english.detail: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the warlock trainer Maximillion. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
english.progress:
I bid you welcome, brother/sister. I knew you would come. It was only a matter of time.

What I said interested you, didn't it? I hit a chord... something inside you knew what I claimed was truth. Good.

Know this though: I am no traitor to Sylvanas. If anything, she would appreciate my claims considering it was her own beliefs that has put the Forsaken in the position it is now.
english.complete:
I mentioned a slave still being a slave, no matter the master. Do you remember? We both know that it is that type of control--that type of power--that now drives us. We seek to have creatures serve us. We know we are more powerful and deserve more respect than others give us ... and so now we look to take it.

I will be your ally in this struggle--the struggle for our own freedom. Freedom to seek our own allegiances. When you feel ready, return to me and I will teach you all I know.

1470.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Piercing the Veil
english.objective: Bring Venya Marthand 3 Rattlecage Skulls.
english.detail:
Greetings, child. I can see that you are still young in the ways of the warlock, power still eluding your grasp. I can sense your eagerness to learn.

And you will learn.

There is no strength in ignorance. Knowledge is our greatest power. Through its application, we can control the chaotic magics and beings of the void, bending them to our will.

I will show you how to bind a servant to your will, but first you must bring me three skulls of the rattlecage skeletons near the abandoned smithy.
english.progress:
Your power is little now, though I suspect already you sense the possibilities.

Even the dead might feel alive, with that power coursing through us.
english.complete:
Though you are still untested and young in your learning, you have proven that you possess sufficient ability to master the summoning and binding of an imp. Do not be deceived by an imp's size. Though it lacks physical strength, it possesses powers and a cleverness that will serve you well.

Attend me carefully, <name>, for I will not repeat this lesson, and I will leave its mastery to you.

98601.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: A Difficult Path
english.objective: Read the Consecrated Scroll and speak to Aramis Hammerhand in the church in Deathknell.
english.detail:
While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine it's of some importance to a paladin like yourself.

Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.

90902.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Rediscovering the Light
english.objective: Heal 5 Injured Deathguard with your Holy Light ability.
english.detail:
I am proud to welcome another newly risen paladin to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others. 

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.

91208.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Coming to Terms
english.objective: Find the Frightened Paladin in Deathknell.
english.detail:
Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.

These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened paladin who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.

98389.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: A Light in the Darkness
english.objective: Free 6 Webbed Victims in Night's Web Hollow for Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell.
english.detail:
Greetings, <Class>. Yes, I am a paladin. Not even death can stop the Light.

This is something my kind have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but I am not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.

5651.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: In Favor of Darkness
english.objective: Speak to Dark Cleric Beryl in Tirisfal Glades.
english.detail:
There are many lessons that the Forsaken have learned through experience--things that some races can only begin to fathom. And although our path lies in darkness, you will find that a great many things rely on both the light and the dark. Your lessons shall teach you to use both... and with discretion. But heed my words: never forget we were forged in corruption and left to rot like so much carrion. The Darkness is our home.

Seek out Dark Cleric Beryl in Brill when you're ready to learn more.
english.complete: Finally, you've arrived. Your faith alone will not allow you to pass the trials before you, young one. A sense of urgency and some ambition will help too.

91209.sourceKind: Forever database English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Continue Your Training
english.objective: Follow the road east out of Deathknell to find the town of Brill. Report to Shari Stilwell to continue your training.
english.detail:
Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training. 

One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a paladin traveling through Forsaken lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.
